title: Inlet Beach "Pompano Palms" 296 Pompano St
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Private pool and sitting spa* Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $115 per day.- Elevator- Outdoor fireplace- 6 adult bikes- 2 Laundry rooms- Carriage house- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Paradise awaits at Pompano Palms, a beautiful Inlet Beach Main House—and Carriage House—collectively sleeping up to 17 guests. Boasting 6 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms, 2 half bathrooms, and exceptional outdoor spaces, this home is a perfect beach haven for making memories with friends and family.Appointed with all the hallmarks of opulent coastal living, this gated property welcomes guests into an idyllic courtyard with a swimming pool, sitting spa, grill, luxurious lanai, and outdoor fireplace. Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, a foldable glass wall connects the pool deck to the Main House’s first-floor kitchen. Meander inside for snacks and a drink at the 6-stool breakfast bar. The adjacent living area is perfect for relaxing with a comfy sectional, armchairs, and Smart TV. This level includes 1 guest bedroom with a king bed—each bedroom on the property enjoys a private bathroom.Take the in-home elevator to the second floor, where timber beams and dramatic light fixtures create a lavish gathering space. The ornate kitchen’s Bertazzoni stove and marble countertops are a chef’s dream. Serve dinner at the grand 10-person dining table, with 5 additional seats at the breakfast bar. Off the sumptuous living space, a beautifully furnished balcony beckons guests to share a pitcher of sangria as the sun sets. At evening’s end, retire to the guest bedroom with a king bed on this level.The top floor hosts a gorgeous primary bedroom and a guest bedroom, both with a king bed and porch, as well as a bunk room with 1 twin-over-twin bed and 1 twin-over-full bed.On the fourth level, curl up on the plush bed swing or patio sectional to enjoy the sparkling turquoise water view while indulging in a nightcap from the wet bar.In the Carriage House, guests will find a lovely kitchen, living space, balcony, and a guest bedroom with 1 king bed and 1 twin-over-twin bunk bed.Experience an extravagant Inlet Beach getaway at Pompano Palms. Parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway, a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle, and 6 complimentary adult bikes makes it easy to explore. Beach access is a 2-minute walk away at the end of Wall Street. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 17):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateTHIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin and Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyFOURTH FLOOR:-Patio with Gulf viewsCARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Indoor fireplaces are not for guest use.*Central air vacuum is not for guest use.*Please note that there is construction in the area.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Inlet Beach "Pompano Palms" 296 Pompano St Inlet Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-222184 Bedrooms 6 Beds 10 Sleeps 17 Full Baths 6 Half Baths 2 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf views - 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Private pool and sitting spa* Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $115 per day. - Elevator - Outdoor fireplace - 6 adult bikes - 2 Laundry rooms - Carriage house - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Paradise awaits at Pompano Palms, a beautiful Inlet Beach Main House—and Carriage House—collectively sleeping up to 17 guests. Boasting 6 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms, 2 half bathrooms, and exceptional outdoor spaces, this home is a perfect beach haven for making memories with friends and family. Appointed with all the hallmarks of opulent coastal living, this gated property welcomes guests into an idyllic courtyard with a swimming pool, sitting spa, grill, luxurious lanai, and outdoor fireplace. Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, a foldable glass wall connects the pool deck to the Main House’s first-floor kitchen. Meander inside for snacks and a drink at the 6-stool breakfast bar. The adjacent living area is perfect for relaxing with a comfy sectional, armchairs, and Smart TV. This level includes 1 guest bedroom with a king bed—each bedroom on the property enjoys a private bathroom. Take the in-home elevator to the second floor, where timber beams and dramatic light fixtures create a lavish gathering space. The ornate kitchen’s Bertazzoni stove and marble countertops are a chef’s dream. Serve dinner at the grand 10-person dining table, with 5 additional seats at the breakfast bar. Off the sumptuous living space, a beautifully furnished balcony beckons guests to share a pitcher of sangria as the sun sets. At evening’s end, retire to the guest bedroom with a king bed on this level. The top floor hosts a gorgeous primary bedroom and a guest bedroom, both with a king bed and porch, as well as a bunk room with 1 twin-over-twin bed and 1 twin-over-full bed. On the fourth level, curl up on the plush bed swing or patio sectional to enjoy the sparkling turquoise water view while indulging in a nightcap from the wet bar. In the Carriage House, guests will find a lovely kitchen, living space, balcony, and a guest bedroom with 1 king bed and 1 twin-over-twin bunk bed. Experience an extravagant Inlet Beach getaway at Pompano Palms. Parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway, a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle, and 6 complimentary adult bikes makes it easy to explore. Beach access is a 2-minute walk away at the end of Wall Street. Book today!
